auto_closed: {raffle:targets}, congratulations! The raffle drew {raffle:count} winner(s) from {raffle:entrants} entries. Winners, type !claim within {raffle:claim} min to confirm!
auto_empty: The raffle closed with no entries. Nobody to draw.
cancelled: The raffle was cancelled. No winner will be drawn.
claim.late: @{raffle:user} the claim window for that prize has closed.
claim.none: There is no raffle prize waiting for @{raffle:user} to claim. Winners: type !claim!
draw.empty: No one entered the raffle. Nobody to draw.
join.already: @{raffle:user} you are already in this raffle ({raffle:count} entered).
join.closed: @{raffle:user} no raffle is running right now.
joined: @{raffle:user} you're in! {raffle:count} entered so far. Good luck!
last.confirmed: Last raffle: {raffle:targets} won from {raffle:entrants} entries ({raffle:confirmed}/{raffle:total} confirmed).
last.empty: The last raffle closed with no entries.
last.none: No raffle has been drawn here yet.
open.already: A raffle is already running! Type !join to enter it.
opened: Raffle is LIVE! Type !join to enter. Drawing in {raffle:mins} min!
remind: Raffle reminder: ~{raffle:mins} min left! {raffle:count} entered so far. Type !join! Winners must !claim.
status.closed: No raffle is running. Mods can start one with !raffle open <minutes>.
status.open: Raffle is live with {raffle:count} entered. Drawing in ~{raffle:mins} min! Type !join!
won: {raffle:targets}, congratulations! You won the raffle ({raffle:count} winner(s) from {raffle:entrants})! Type !claim within {raffle:claim} min to confirm your prize!
